abstract: We analyzed primary tumor tissue from 89 clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumor patients for proliferating cell nuclear antigen expression and histological features to determine if these elements could distinguish pathological stage I (52 patients) from pathological stage II disease or patients who later had relapse (37). Using a monoclonal antibody (PC10) developed for use in archival tissue, nuclear proliferating cell nuclear antigen expression was immunohistochemically measured for the overall tumor (total proliferating cell nuclear antigen) and for each neoplastic cell type present. In addition, the primary tumor was examined for the presence of vascular invasion and determination of the percentage of tumor composed of embryonal carcinoma. Univariate logistic regression analysis revealed higher total (p = 0.0001) and higher embryonal carcinoma proliferating cell nuclear antigen expression (p = 0.0437) to be statistically significant risk factors for occult disease, correctly predicting its presence 73% and 61.5% of the time, respectively. More importantly, the presence of vascular invasion and a higher percentage embryonal carcinoma were highly significant risk factors for occult disease and were truly predictive in 80.4% and 77.2% of the cases, respectively. Multivariate logistic regression analysis revealed a combination of vascular invasion and percentage embryonal carcinoma to be the best model to predict occult disease correctly (85.9%). The addition of total or embryonal carcinoma proliferating cell nuclear antigen expression did not improve the clinical use of the model containing vascular invasion and percentage embryonal carcinoma. Although proliferating cell nuclear antigen expression mirrors the biological behavior of clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumor to some degree, assessment of vascular invasion and percentage embryonal carcinoma has greater clinical use.
abstract_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者89名について、原発腫瘍組織を解析し、PCNA発現と組織学的特徴から病理病期I（52例）と病理病期IIまたは後に再発した患者（37例）を区別できるかを検討した。増殖細胞核抗原（PCNA）の発現は、モノクローナル抗体PC10を用いて免疫組織化学的に測定し、腫瘍全体（総PCNA）と存在する各腫瘍細胞型についてそれぞれ評価した。また、原発腫瘍について脈管侵襲の有無と、胎児性癌が占める割合を求めた。単変量ロジスティック回帰分析では、総PCNA（p=0.0001）と胎児性癌のPCNA発現（p=0.0437）が潜在病変の有意な危険因子であり、それぞれ73%と61.5%の症例で正しく予測した。さらに重要なことに、脈管侵襲の存在と胎児性癌の割合の高さは潜在病変の高度に有意な危険因子であり、それぞれ80.4%と77.2%の症例で真に予測的であった。多変量ロジスティック回帰分析では、脈管侵襲と胎児性癌の割合の組み合わせが、潜在病変を正しく予測する最良のモデルであった（85.9%）。総PCNAまたは胎児性癌のPCNA発現を加えても、脈管侵襲と胎児性癌の割合を含むモデルの臨床的有用性は改善しなかった。PCNA発現は臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の生物学的挙動をある程度反映するが、脈管侵襲と胎児性癌の割合の評価の方が臨床的有用性は高い。
